title: ExtractedMemoryApproval
description: What approving a document's extracted memories does: how many it approves and which it leaves for a person to decide.

approved.description: Unprocessed extracted memories approved; on a preview, those approval would approve.

failed.description: Unprocessed extracted memories whose approval was refused or that changed while being approved. They stay pending.

needsDecision.description: Unprocessed extracted memories left pending because another pending or Approved memory of the same document answers the same question.
